decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ introduction already records that prize wins appear on the Winners page and are claimable with one click.
The claim interface and winner-announcement location do not change the VRF selection method, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification surface.
The payout-claim presentation does not change the Small Block prize amount, eligibility, draw cadence, funding, or trigger.
The payout-claim presentation does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw trigger.
The source decision does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, independence, or post-draw reset behavior.
The source decision does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, carryover, weighting, or post-draw action.
The prize claim flow does not affect the deferred Discord community server or its launch condition.
The Winners-page claim flow does not alter the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
The source decision does not change the secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, visibility, or use of proceeds.
The source distinguishes automatically transferred commissions from one-click prize claims and leaves the referral commission behavior unchanged.
The prize winner claim interface does not alter primary mint pricing or revenue allocation.
Posting winners on a Winners page and providing one-click claims does not change the required NFT metadata attributes.
